image_prompt: Empty background scene only: a pale off-white surface with soft cool tones and a few small ice-like crystals and water droplets only along the outer edges, bright gentle light. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
